status: PROPOSED by the agent (P05) — not approved. The SRE / service owner approves, changes or rejects each figure.
min_samples_basis: PROPOSED by the agent (P11 r8 O-5 residual) — a class measured with fewer requests (or, for pages, fewer measured pages) reads 'too few samples', never 'within'; blocking mode fails on it. The SRE owner decides the figure.
mode: warn — tools/test/perf-budget-check.js prints over-budget classes and exits 0; the repository variable PERF_BUDGETS_BLOCKING=1 makes it fail the build
measured_on: docs/agent-execution/P05-performance.md — 100 000-ticket rehearsal set, one 4 vCPU sandbox, server and load harness in separate processes

page_data.basis: the vision figure (API p95 < 800 ms); observed p95 451 ms with 5 sessions and no deck, 1 160 ms when decks run in the same process

sync.basis: same as page data (a status read); observed p95 243 ms without decks, 777 ms with decks

write.basis: observed p95 502 ms without decks rounded up with headroom; the field envelope of the run is a rejected test envelope (400 by design), see the report

export.basis: observed p95 304 ms without decks, 603 ms with decks; a file a person waits for, so more headroom than page data

deck_generation.basis: single all-sites monthly deck 3.3–3.8 s after the P05 fix (22 s before); 5 decks at once p95 15.3 s — over this figure, which is the point: decks run in the request process

page.basis: the vision figure (first usable page < 3 s), read from the browser-journey artefacts (first_usable_ms p95, load p95 when absent); worst page counts
